events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond's big day
angles.copy: Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) – it's James Bond Day! Which iconic 007 theme tune is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and writer, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: A master of comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite John Cleese character or moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album memories
angles.copy: 48 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. Which track from this double LP is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly unforgettable.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's lasting impact
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic chameleon of rock, David Bowie, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible artistry and influence of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Which era of Bowie is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: Happy 92nd heavenly birthday to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley! His music is as electrifying as ever.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar icon turns 83
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter, Sir Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod at 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still got that distinctive rasp and those timeless hits.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness frontman's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down with those classic tunes.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young at 71
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still love those 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary American singer-songwriter, actress, and businesswoman, Dolly Parton, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating Dolly
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her legacy shines brighter than ever.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and television personality, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gazza
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! What's your favourite Gary-penned hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-born British singer, known for a string of 80s hits, Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's 77th
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the smooth-voiced Billy Ocean! Still got us feeling 'Caribbean Queen' vibes.
